audit_scope: composition plan only; no production source mutation

invariants.1_one_kernel: PASS: groundwater coupling composes the same canonical SWAP kernel and does not define a coupling-specific SWAP version
invariants.2_kernel_io_separation: PASS: groundwater/MODFLOW integration is behind a typed external service/gateway; no file, format, path or parser contract enters the kernel
invariants.3_explicit_data_separation: PASS: physical boundary data, application/numerical policy, committed state, coupling mapping and diagnostics remain distinct
invariants.4_compact_persistent_state: PASS: only committed state plus minimal coupling lineage/mapping/ledger continuation metadata may persist
invariants.5_scratch_per_worker: PASS: solver vectors, Jacobians and trial-only tangents are explicitly nonpersistent
invariants.6_scalable_memory_layout: PASS: MultiSWAP coupling uses tile/cell IDs and batchable contracts without requiring object-heavy per-column solver ownership
invariants.7_transactional_timesteps: PASS: both sides checkpoint at t0; predictor/corrector are trials; rejected work never mutates committed state; accepted corrector commits once
invariants.8_recomputation_warm_start: PASS: numerical guesses may be reused but physical trial origin remains the committed t0 checkpoint
invariants.9_generic_time: PASS: all coupling is over finite [t0,t1]; no day/month/year primitive or midnight assumption
invariants.10_flexible_coupling_windows: PASS: delta_T is generic and an outer controller may choose smaller/larger windows; failed windows can request a smaller new window
invariants.11_coupling_core_functionality: PASS: predictor/corrector, rollback, interface residuals, mass ledger and response tangents are first-class planned runtime capabilities
invariants.12_groundwater_interface_contract: PASS_WITH_GATE: H_SWAP approximately H_GW requires explicit qualified H_interface_tol; q_SWAP=-q_GW is exact by assignment; final admission cannot proceed without the head-policy binding qualification
invariants.13_mass_conservation_absolute: PASS: no mass tolerance exists; rejected trials excluded; exact opposite interface assignment and complete SWAP mass are mandatory
invariants.14_interface_sensitivities_first_class: PASS_WITH_DEPENDENCY: definitive F-KT15/F-CI49 carries accepted interface sensitivity; F-GC23 must qualify whole-window composition before production admission
invariants.15_limit_coupling_cost: PASS: normal path is one predictor plus one corrector; finite-difference trajectories are nonstructural; no same-window coupling retry loop
invariants.16_multiswap_primary: PASS: explicit cell/tile mapping, worker isolation, batching and shared execution are in the production plan
invariants.17_no_1_to_1_modflow_relation: PASS: one groundwater cell may map to multiple tiles and q_cell is area-fraction weighted
invariants.18_deep_vadose_external: PASS: direct profile rejects TRANSFER_ZONE as out of scope; future transfer storage remains an external runtime component
invariants.19_mass_conserving_component_transition: PASS_WITH_FUTURE_GATE: future direct/transfer switching must explicitly account for stored transfer-zone water before detach/attach
invariants.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: PASS: coupling consumes the canonical soil-water service/result contract rather than Richards internals
invariants.21_reuse_swap_physics: PASS: no coupling-specific copies of crop, ET, drainage, irrigation or surface physics are planned
invariants.22_no_headcalc_internal_dependency: PASS: coupling consumes typed boundary/result/sensitivity contracts only
invariants.23_physics_solver_policy_separation: PASS: H_interface_tol, H_app, A_temporal, bounded iteration counts and window adaptation are numerical/application policy, not physical options
invariants.24_predictable_runtime: PASS_WITH_QUALIFICATION_GATE: normal two-trajectory path and fail-closed smaller-window request bound coupling-level work; final admission must include difficult-column cost cases
invariants.25_reference_mode: PASS: F-GC27 must retain reference mode and use it for qualification of reduced/balanced/throughput behavior
invariants.26_runtime_diagnostics: PASS: per-window residuals, mass, provenance, tangent usage, retry/solver cost and failure classification are mandatory
invariants.27_optional_functionality_scales_with_us: PASS: coupling, transfer-zone and special mapping state exists only for participating columns/tiles
invariants.28_runtime_coupler_system_composition: PASS: tile fractions, groundwater-cell mapping, external adapter and deep-vadose routing live outside SWAP kernel
invariants.29_no_silent_dependencies: PASS: no .swp, midnight, one-day, direct-MODFLOW-type or hidden numeric tolerance assumption is allowed
invariants.30_explicit_architecture_review: PASS: F-GC16 records authority, minimal profile, owner DAG, parallel waves, admission gates and this invariant audit before implementation

critical_nonnegotiable_downstream_gates: F-CI49 canonical admission of definitive F-KT15 before production coupling code consumes accepted sensitivity transport
explicit common head datum and unit/sign mapping
externally governed non-default H_interface_tol binding consistent with application/temporal accuracy policy
exact q_SWAP=-q_GW pairing and zero-tolerance interface mass ledger
whole-window tangent qualification before tangent-based production correction claims
concrete external groundwater adapter conformance before end-to-end production admission
forbidden_shortcuts: reuse H_temporal_budget directly as H_interface_tol without separately qualified allocation semantics
use solver nonlinear tolerance, old transaction temporal tolerance or predictor perturbation as coupling head tolerance
book predictor/rejected fluxes into any accepted mass ledger
add MODFLOW data structures or I/O to the SWAP kernel
treat deep-vadose q_SWAP_bottom as direct groundwater recharge
require +/-delta full SWAP trajectories on every production window
repair final admission failures by opportunistic cross-owner source edits
